_what: The v3 training mixture's registered identity, as consumed by v2/write_verdict_v2.py --version v3. Created 2026-10-01 so a v3 verdict can cite its OWN mixture instead of v2's.

_sources.mixture_rows_and_sha256: docs/PLAN-V3.md:147 and docs/GO-NO-GO-v3-2026-09-30.md:26 (sha256 verified by run-v3-arm.sh's mixture identity gate before launch)
_sources.training_pace: measured from the live run's own progress line, receipts/cyberguard-lora-v3.json is authoritative once written
_sources._honesty: Every figure below is either registered in the plan, recorded in a named evidence file, or measured from the live run. Nothing is projected silently: projections are labelled as such.

recipe: v2 Arm B (LoRA r=32, lr 1e-4 cosine + warmup 0.03, batch 2 x grad_accum 8, max_seq 2048, seed 0, 1.0 epoch, augment_system true / sys_variants 4, assistant-only loss)
single_arm_note: v3 trains ONE adapter. The v2 A-vs-B Claim 2 contrast is NOT APPLICABLE to v3 and is not fabricated here.
epoch_presentations_note: 140,545 presentations of the 127,767 rows in one epoch (duplicates preserved; the trainer reads the flat mixture verbatim).

training_window.basis_note: MEASURED from the live v3 run (step counter and elapsed time read from the trainer's own progress line at 91% of the epoch, 2026-10-01). This is ~1.5x v2's 11.0 h/epoch because the v3 mixture is far heavier per presentation: 735.1 tokens/presentation against v2's 323.4. That ratio is why the pre-launch max_minutes=1320 (derived from v2's rate) would have stopped the run at 60% of the epoch, and why it was raised to 3300 before launch. No hyperparameter changed.
training_window.ceiling_vs_measured: 3300 min = 55 h ceiling against a measured ~37 h epoch: ample headroom, and the ceiling never bound.

mixture_identity_gate.rule: sha256 and row count of the flat mixture are asserted BEFORE launch; a mismatch refuses to start.

known_limitations: Public-benchmark improvement at this scale is small: v2 Arm B measured +0.33 pp pooled over base on the 610 references (+0.80 pp CyberMetric-500, -1.82 pp SecQA). v3 has NO measured improvement yet -- it cannot have one until the adapter exists.
Training loss falling is NOT evidence of model improvement; it measures fit to the training data. Improvement is measured only by the section 8 gates.
